user.title: Charging Stations Austria (ladestellen.at)
user.description: Choose what to set up: a live-filterable overview of the nearest stations within a radius, or a single favorite charge point/site tracked independently of any location.

radius.title: Radius overview
radius.description: Sets up charging station tracking around a location, sourced from the official Austrian charging point directory ladestellen.at (E-Control). You need a free personal API key: register at admin.ladestellen.at → API and enter `homeassistant.local` as the authorized domain — the key arrives by e-mail. Latitude/longitude default to your Home Assistant home location. Add the integration again for a different radius or location. Filters (minimum power, plug type, status, operator) are adjusted afterwards live via number/select entities. Note: the source API returns the ~100 nearest stations, so very dense areas are capped at the 100 nearest sites regardless of the radius.

favorite.title: Favorite charge point
favorite.description: Enter the charge point's EvseID directly (printed on the charger, e.g. AT*DAE*E0002115), or leave it empty and search near a location instead — you'll get a list to pick from on the next screen. Add the integration again for another favorite.

data.station_id: Charge point EvseID (optional — leave empty to search instead)
data.latitude: Latitude (used only if EvseID is empty)
data.longitude: Longitude (used only if EvseID is empty)
data.radius_km: Search radius (km — used only if EvseID is empty)
data.min_power_kw: Minimum power (kW, used only if EvseID is empty)
data.plug_type: Plug type (used only if EvseID is empty)

favorite_pick.title: Pick your favorite charge point
favorite_pick.description: {count} charge points found nearby, closest first. Entries marked with 📍 are whole sites (all charge points there combined into one favorite) instead of a single charge point.

favorite_scope.title: One charge point or the whole site?
favorite_scope.description: {evse_id} is one of {count} charge points at {site}. Pin only this charge point, or the whole site with all its charge points?

favorite_confirm.title: Confirm favorite
favorite_confirm.description: Found: {what}. You can give it a custom name before it is created.

abort.already_configured: This location/radius or charge point is already configured.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Check the key, and make sure it was registered for the domain homeassistant.local.
error.station_not_found: No charge point with this EvseID was found.
error.no_stations_found: No charge points found within this radius.

init.title: Per-plug-type sensors
init.description: Each selected plug type gets its own sensor counting the available charge points of that type within this radius. These sensors respect the minimum-power and operator filters but ignore the live plug-type and status filters, so they keep their meaning while the map is being filtered.

data.plug_type_sensors: Plug types with a dedicated sensor

abort.no_options: Only radius entries have options. Favorites are configured when they are added.
